# A2v10 Platform

> A2v10 is a full-stack platform for building business applications on SQL Server, ASP.NET Core, and Vue.js.
> Developers describe data (SQL), model (model.json), and UI (XAML) — the platform builds the application.

- [SQL](sql.md): Naming, markers, stored procedures, the TVP+MERGE save pattern, tree and grouping models
- [XAML (UI Markup)](xaml.md): Server-compiled Vue.js views — Page/Dialog roots, binding, controls, layouts
- [Model Configuration](model.md): model.json — actions, dialogs, popups, commands, reports, file upload
